triage.kind_span: Tekla World Healthcare Fund (the "Trust") is issuing non-transferable rights ("Rights") to its Shareholders of record as of the close of business on March 8, 2021

subject_names.span: Tekla World Healthcare Fund (the "Trust") is issuing non-transferable rights

subject_tickers.span: New York Stock Exchange Symbol: THW

security_class.span: one (1) common share of beneficial interest ("Share") of the Trust for every three (3) Rights held

rights_per_share.span: You will receive one Right for each whole Share that you hold of record as of the Record Date

rights_per_new_share.span: one (1) common share of beneficial interest ("Share") of the Trust for every three (3) Rights held

price_reference.span: formula equal to 95% of the volume weighted average price of a Share on the NYSE on the date on which the Offer expires

price_pct.span: formula equal to 95% of the volume weighted average price of a Share on the NYSE on the date on which the Offer expires

price_floor_pct_nav.span: then the Subscription Price will be 90% of the Trust's NAV per Share at the close of trading on the NYSE on the Expiration Date

record_date.span: Shareholders of record as of the close of business on March 8, 2021 (the "Record Date")

expiration_date.span: which starts on March 16, 2021 and ends at 5:00 p.m., Eastern Time on April 6, 2021, unless the Offer is extended

transferable.span: The Rights are non-transferable, which means that the Rights may not be purchased or sold

over_subscription.span: The Trust may, at its discretion, issue up to an additional 25% of the Shares in the Offer to honor over-subscription requests

max_new_shares.span: to subscribe for an aggregate of 10,077,635 common shares of beneficial interest

notes: Prospectus dated 2021-03-04 (424B1). Subscription price = 95% of the 5-day VWAP of the market price ending on the expiration date, but if that is below 90% of NAV at the close on the expiration date, price = 90% of NAV; categorised as market with a 90% NAV floor (price_reference could arguably be other or greater_of_nav_and_market). Expiration date is 2021-04-06 unless extended. max_new_shares is the base 10,077,635; the filing allows up to a further 25% (2,519,409 shares, total 12,597,044) at the Trust's discretion. Estimated subscription price $17.00 on 2021-02-26 data.
